# HodgeLociCI

> Macaulay2 package for Hodge loci (Noether-Lefschetz loci) of classes r[Y1] + s[Y2] of two linear or
> complete-intersection cycles in a smooth hypersurface of even dimension: a first-order excess calculator, a
> second-order obstruction check, and higher-order expansions at the Fermat point. AI-generated and not yet reviewed
> by a human; every result table carries a label (EXACT, MOD p, PROVED in an unreviewed AI-written note, COMPUTED ONLY).
> Author: Timothy Seifert. Licence: MIT.

Requires Macaulay2 (tested with 1.22). Load with `needsPackage("HodgeLociCI", FileName => "M2/HodgeLociCI.m2")`.
Smoke test, from the repository root: `M2 --script examples/quickstart.m2` prints `RESULT <name> <value>` lines.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, commands, calling conventions, pitfalls, rules for changing the repository
- [README.md](README.md): what the package does, status of the mathematics, comparison with existing software
- [docs/API.md](docs/API.md): every exported function with its signature (options and defaults included), one line each

## What has already been found (read before starting new work)

- [discoveries/README.md](discoveries/README.md): the registry of results, negative results, dead ends, corrections and open problems; status vocabulary; rules for adding entries
- [discoveries/registry.yaml](discoveries/registry.yaml): the machine-readable registry (178 entries); `python3 discoveries/check_registry.py --list` prints one line per entry
- [discoveries/06_ruled_out_and_dead_ends.md](discoveries/06_ruled_out_and_dead_ends.md): what failed and why
- [discoveries/07_open_problems.md](discoveries/07_open_problems.md): open questions, each with one next step
- [discoveries/NOTATION.md](discoveries/NOTATION.md): the setting and every symbol

## Worked examples (captured sessions)

- [docs/01_excess_calculator.md](docs/01_excess_calculator.md): first-order excess, by degrees and at a point
- [docs/02_level_dichotomy.md](docs/02_level_dichotomy.md): the cases tau < 0 and tau >= 0
- [docs/03_second_order.md](docs/03_second_order.md): second-order obstruction on the excess directions
- [docs/04_fermat_certificate.md](docs/04_fermat_certificate.md): verifying an arc or obstruction certificate at the Fermat point
- [docs/05_tangent_codimension_two_determinants.md](docs/05_tangent_codimension_two_determinants.md): tangent codimension of a Hodge locus from an ideal

## Validation

- [tests/SOURCES.md](tests/SOURCES.md): the source of every expected value (Movasati, Kloosterman, Villaflor Loyola, Maclean, and the project's own results)
- [tests/README.md](tests/README.md): how to run the validation suite and what each test covers

## Run it without installing Macaulay2

- [docker/README.md](docker/README.md): Docker image (Macaulay2 1.22 + package + MCP server); `docker build -t hodgelocici .` then `docker run --rm hodgelocici` runs the quickstart check
- [mcp/README.md](mcp/README.md): MCP server with the tools excess_formula, second_order_check, fermat_expansion, registry_search; `python -m hodgelocici_mcp` or `docker run --rm -i hodgelocici python -m hodgelocici_mcp`; every output carries its status label
